changed.headline: A machine-learning model that chose which mental-health micro-intervention to send 49 young people showed no benefit on positive or negative affect, and only a borderline gain in momentary resilience over random assignment.

Because of AI, nursing students in Jordan who used a mobile app with an AI chatbot on substance abuse prevention gained substantially in knowledge (within-group effect size 1.35) while a control group's scores did not change.

Because of AI, adults with untreated depression or anxiety who did eight problem-solving sessions with Lumen, a voice-based AI coach, had their HADS distress score fall 5.85 points over 18 weeks, against 2.76 points on a waitlist.

Because of AI guidance, operators with no ultrasound training could scan for deep vein thrombosis, and a specialist ultrasound could be avoided in 35.32% of patients, with triage sensitivity of 92.86%.

Because of AI, anesthesiology trainees in Wuhan who practiced with AI virtual standardized patients scored 88.2 on a 100-point simulated-performance rubric, against 80.4 with simulation and debriefing and 78.0 with conventional teaching.

Because of AI, third-year medical students who spent 10 minutes with two Socratic-prompted GPT-3.5 chatbots gained 8.9 points on a 15-question test, against 3.7 points for students who read the textbook for the same time, in a randomised trial.

Because of AI, a deep learning CT reconstruction algorithm let a pulmonary CT angiography protocol cut effective radiation dose by 84.93% in a randomized trial of low-BMI patients while keeping diagnostic image quality.

Because of AI, high school female soccer players who got GPT-4o personalized sleep feedback had 2% higher sleep efficiency than players given generic sleep information, in a pilot randomized trial of 25 players.

Because of AI, caregivers in Japan answered 0.30 more of 7 HPV vaccine questions correctly after using a GPT-4o chatbot than after reading the government leaflet, in a randomized trial of 848 caregivers; their vaccination decisions did not differ.

Because of AI decision support, nurse-led teledermoscopy clinics in New Zealand and Australia forwarded lesions that were malignant at 25.5 per 1,000 against 15.7 per 1,000 at clinics without it, across 1,102,382 lesions.

Because of AI, adults in rural Odisha villages who got four weeks of chatbot-guided oral health education over WhatsApp went from 28% to 64% brushing twice daily, against 30% to 37% in control villages given a health talk and leaflet.
